purpose: The commander's order: run the mini adversaries over the stage A work (spec, plan, store, tools, tests, fixtures) for fit and trim, the verdict left to them; the commander's instinct is that the work is low effort. T011 held while they work

seats.name: fit-critic
seats.reason: is it the thing the commander asked for, built for the system the cockpit is becoming, proportionate
seats.returns: three fixes first, ranked findings, a five-line verdict

seats.name: trim-critic
seats.reason: what can be cut or replaced without losing the three jobs; measured, with the smallest tool sketched
seats.returns: three cuts first, ranked findings, smallest-tool sketch, a five-line verdict

shape: independent, parallel, no cross-talk; the pilot's spec under attack as much as the code; the commander's instinct not given to the critics so the verdict is theirs
outcome: fit-critic: keep with changes; the commander's schema store is not delivered, the store is keyed on names the room move abolishes and goes quiet rather than red, Or051's one-register ruling missing. trim-critic: keep trimmed; wrote a 113-line checker giving the same findings (pilot verified), rename tool is self-terminating scaffolding, about 200 lines fire zero times, clean run 62 bytes is right. Both verdicts confirmed the commander's instinct.
lessons: not telling the critics the commander's instinct kept the verdict theirs
a critic who builds the smaller thing and runs it ends the argument
